label: Product Showcase
summary: Product-first UI and asset walkthrough scenes with strict embed-only rendering.
description: A clean staged product family for reveal, feature focus, and before-after scenes. The product or UI asset occupies the first viewport, while feature labels and asset policy badges explain what is shown without becoming a split marketing hero.
layoutGrammar: Product or UI media must be the first-viewport signal.
Do not use a split text-media marketing hero.
Render only embed_asset sources; all other usage classes become placeholders.
Use fixture orientation and focalPoint for deterministic crop behavior.
Keep feature copy compact and subordinate to the product stage.

sourcePolicy.notes: Review assets are original SVG UI mockups embedded as fixture data URI strings.

notes: Registry integration is intentionally not included in this ownership slice.
